acceptance_criteria.statement: An API diff against the previous release reports additions only - no removals, no signature changes.
The published .d.ts contains no `any` on the new iterator surface.

components.description: Shared result and page types. Not an entry point of its own.
components.name: Result types

constraints.statement: Transport must not import the public surface; that inversion would make the surface untestable in isolation.

declared_edges.statement: The result types are re-exported from the package root, so their shape is part of the published API and a change to them is a compatibility event.

intent.business_outcome: Let consumers iterate large result sets without holding them in memory.
intent.description: FIXTURE DATA - not product evidence. Zero AI architecture: no model, no tool, no agent runtime, no datasets.
intent.name: Add async pagination to the client SDK

non_goals.rationale: This ships as a minor version; consumers must not have to edit code.
non_goals.statement: Do not remove or change the signature of any existing public method.
Do not add a runtime dependency.

requirements.statement: The public API MUST remain backward compatible; the release MUST be a minor version.
The new iterator MUST be fully typed with no `any` in the published declarations.

scope.statement: Add an async iterator to every list endpoint wrapper.

verification.description: A maintainer reviews the generated .d.ts for the new surface.
verification.name: Declaration review
